_about: The Run The Pitch club pool (data/club_players.json). fetch.mjs pulls from Wikidata, build.mjs makes the file, check.mjs is the gate. The Rosters Agent's. Notes: runthe-gg-kb games/soccer/features/soccer-club-data.md.

leagues.name: Premier League
leagues._season_teams: A season Wikidata lists no clubs for (2025-26 as of 2026-11-26). Wikidata's list wins once it has one.

_open_spell_years: A spell with no end date counts only if it started within this many years of today. Wikidata often never closes an old spell.
_rule: A man with no World Cup is rated from his fame (how many Wikipedias have an article on him), matched to the World Cup ratings of the men at the same clubs, never above rule_ceiling.
_nations: Wikidata's spelling of a country, mapped to players_all's, so the game's flags resolve. A nation never at a World Cup goes in no_world_cup instead.
_no_world_cup: Nations that never went to a World Cup, so players_all has no spelling for them: they ship as Wikidata spells them.
_ignore_nations: Not a football nation (a state of several, or a regional side): skipped, so the next nation on the man's item is used.
_max_shrink: An automatic refresh fails the gate if it ships fewer than this share of the last file's men, or drops a club decade the last file had.
